title: System & integrations
description: Which external services are configured, why others are not, and the state of background jobs. Secrets are never shown.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Features that depend on a service that is not configured stay hidden or show a clear “not configured” state in the apps.
integrations.emptyBody: The server did not report any provider status.
integrations.checkSkipped: Nothing to check: the provider is not configured.
integrations.perInstanceNote: “Last success” and “last error” are tracked per API instance since it started.

jobs.title: Background jobs
jobs.description: Queues processed by workers (imports, image processing, notifications…). Refreshes every 30 seconds.
jobs.emptyBody: The server did not report any job queues.
jobs.redisDown: Redis is unreachable: background jobs are paused and queue counts are unknown.
jobs.workersDisabledHere: Workers are disabled on this API instance (JOBS_ENABLED=false); another instance must process the queues.
